name: lever-job-feed
title: Lever Job Feed – Filters, Salary & EU Sites
description: Job postings from any company that hires through Lever, from Lever's public Postings API. Server-side team, department, location and commitment filters, salary ranges, workplace type, EU instance support, requirement lists and a daily new-postings mode. $0.0015 per job; 20 jobs cost $0.03005.
